title: Scaling LLM Test-Time Compute Optimally
authors: C. Snell, J. Lee, K. Xu, A. Kumar
before: Scaling meant training compute: more parameters, more data.
problem: Nobody had systematically compared spending compute at training time against spending it at inference.
breakthrough: A compute-optimal analysis of inference strategies, showing extra thinking can beat a much larger model on some problems.
why: It gave the reasoning-model era its theoretical footing, weeks before o1 shipped.
next: o1 and o3, then DeepSeek-R1 and the open reasoning models.
inherits: Inference compute as a second scaling axis.
